verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an interactive graph view of notes and connections, or filtering of such a view. Page/block references, linked references, queries and the whiteboard canvas are adjacent features: references build links, queries filter content, and whiteboards place notes on a manually arranged canvas, but none is an explorable graph visualization of the knowledge base.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can explore my knowledge base as an interactive graph of notes and connections, filtered to what I care about
